messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] [stan-math] RowMajor causes ambiguity function call
parts:
All of our functions assume the default column-major layout.
Why do you want to send something in row major?

Also, you want to stick to using all our built-in function
calls rather than using Eigen primitives like .trace() through
which you'll get simple autodiff of the Eigen algorithms rather
than our specialized derivatives.

- Bob

Can you also check that this occurs when you only include the stan/math.hpp header?

So make it look like:
#include <stan/math.hpp>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>


There is a chance that the up-front include of Eigen/Dense could specialize things in a way that isn't coherent with the Stan Math library.
